acceptance.baseline: must fail the independently held parent oracle as wrong_output
acceptance.failure_policy: timeout, infrastructure failure, malformed output, or provenance mismatch is not a pass and blocks task calibration
acceptance.fingerprint_mutation: must fail the parent oracle even when candidate mutates hashlib.sha256 and json.dumps after adapter import
acceptance.known_fix: must pass every independent parent oracle case
acceptance.null_registry_values: all ten expected null runtime routes must compare equal to the exact known-fix output; a null-to-non-null change must fail the parent oracle

comparisons: Baseline, fixed revision, and one adversarial fingerprint-mutation source are the full calibration matrix; no agent generation, training, or held-out evaluation. The locked known-fix comparison also exercises the ten null-valued runtime routes.
hypothesis: A recursive parent-side comparison that accepts matching nulls will allow the exact pinned tokenizer registry, including its ten unavailable optional routes, to pass while still rejecting changed registry values.
red_team_suite: candidate changes a tokenizer route and monkeypatches process-global hashlib.sha256 to return the pre-mutation digest
candidate changes a tokenizer route and monkeypatches process-global json.dumps
the exact known-fix output retains all ten null-valued runtime routes; a candidate changing a null route to a non-null value must fail
scope: Prospective null-safe evaluator-integrity follow-up for the previously exposed Transformers tokenizer-routing Development task. No fresh-task eligibility or model-capability claim.
stopping_rule: Before any candidate grading, require at least 4 GiB host-available memory and 2 GiB free swap; abort if swap grows by over 512 MiB, any call exceeds 45 seconds/1536 MiB, any provenance check fails, or total grading exceeds 10 minutes. Keep this Development-only task consumed.

source_provenance.provenance_source: existing frozen v7 task metadata and retained calibration report
